import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

DATASET_PATH = 'chunks_csv/cyclehire_w005.csv'
ADJACENCY_PATH = 'chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv'

df = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)
adj = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)

# Self-containment ratios
departures = df.groupby('StartBorough').size()
self_contained = df[df['StartBorough'] == df['EndBorough']].groupby('StartBorough').size()
ratios = self_contained.reindex(departures.index, fill_value=0) / departures
ratios = ratios.sort_index()

boroughs = ratios.index.tolist()
n = len(boroughs)

# Build symmetric adjacency dict filtered to the 12 boroughs
adj_dict = {b: set() for b in boroughs}
for _, row in adj.iterrows():
    b = row['borough']
    neigh = row['neighbor']
    if b in adj_dict and neigh in adj_dict:
        adj_dict[b].add(neigh)
        adj_dict[neigh].add(b)

# Print neighbor details
for b in boroughs:
    neighs = sorted(adj_dict[b])
    avg = np.mean([ratios[nbr] for nbr in neighs]) if len(neighs) > 0 else np.nan
    print(f'{b}: ratio={ratios[b]:.4f}, n_neighbors={len(neighs)}, neighbors={neighs}, neighbor_avg={avg:.4f}')

# Row-standardized weight matrix
W = np.zeros((n, n))
for i, b in enumerate(boroughs):
    neighbors = list(adj_dict[b])
    if len(neighbors) > 0:
        for nbr in neighbors:
            W[i, boroughs.index(nbr)] = 1.0 / len(neighbors)

# z-scores and local Moran's I
z = (ratios.values - ratios.mean()) / ratios.std(ddof=0)
local_I = z * (W.dot(z))

# Permutation test with 5000 shuffles
np.random.seed(42)
n_perm = 5000
perm_stats = np.zeros((n_perm, n))
for p in range(n_perm):
    perm_z = np.random.permutation(z)
    perm_stats[p, :] = perm_z * (W.dot(perm_z))

# One-sided p-value (upper tail) for positive local autocorrelation
p_values = np.mean(perm_stats >= local_I - 1e-12, axis=0)

print('\nLocal Moran I and p-values (5000 permutations):')
for b, li, pv in zip(boroughs, local_I, p_values):

mean_ratio = ratios.mean()
